resources.string: Each time window remembers its spacing. Applies to ticks, dots, and triangles.
%1$s between marks on the line. Optional side labels show the window\'s start and end in local 24-hour time.
Recording could not be fully paused. Retry pausing before a battery test.
Readings are stale / Drag to inspect
Graph brightness lives in the watch face editor: Layout & brightness. Choose Faint, Subtle, or Clear.
The graph is hidden in AOD. To keep the numeric heart rate, choose Active + AOD under Heart rate & battery in the face editor.
Sample preview. Invented readings; recording is paused.
Recording is paused. Eligible stored readings are kept. Start recording to resume.
Recording is on. Waiting for the watch to deliver its first readings.

resources.string: Heart-rate and background access are needed to record. You can still use sample preview.
This watch does not offer passive heart-rate readings. Sample preview is available.
Recording could not start. Check permissions and try Start recording again.
History could not be saved or read. Try stopping and erasing history.
Background recovery could not be scheduled. Reopen the app after restarting the watch.
Allow heart-rate access while this app is closed. Readings stay on your watch, with a rolling 24-hour history. Stop and erase at any time.
Recording will stop and stored heart-rate readings will be deleted from this watch.
On Binary Pulse, edit Layout & brightness to choose Faint, Subtle, or Clear with your preferred number of complications. The time window above applies to the face too.
Only on your watch. No account, network access, analytics, or backup. The graph refreshes about every five minutes; sensor delivery and battery impact vary by watch. Missing readings stay as gaps.
Heart-rate history for %1$s. Touch and drag for a recorded time and heart rate. Lift your finger to dismiss.
